description: This team is formed with the purpose of participating in this NASA space apps challenge.
summary:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a storytelling project that brings the stories of NASA's robotic explorers to life through a 2D, child-friendly presentation. Narrated from the first-person perspective of NASA's Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, the story follows its journey from Earth to Mars, its historic first flight, its contributions to Perseverance's exploration, and the eventual end of its mission.
Through dialogue pop-ups, AI-generated character narration, colorful illustrations, and sound effects, the project transforms real space exploration history into an engaging experience for younger audiences.
As the story unfolds, the perspective expands to reveal the robotic explorer featured in the challenge's resources, highlighting the missions, achievements, and lasting contributions.
The project's central message is that even when a mission ends and an explorer falls silent, its discoveries continue to inspire humanity. They may be abandoned, but they should never be forgotten.
details:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten: The Little Helicopter Who Dreamed of Flying is a 2D storytelling presentation that introduces audiences to the lives and achievements of NASA's robotic explorers. The story follows Ingenuity Mars Helicopter from its launch on Earth to its historic flights on Mars and the eventual end of its mission.

The presentation is told entirely from Ingenuity's first-person perspective. Using dialogues, background music, and sound effects, it turns real mission events and scientific information into an accessible visual story.

The project aims to make space exploration more understandable and emotionally engaging, especially for children and younger audiences. Rather than presenting scientific facts as complicated technical information, it introduces them through storytelling and character perspectives.

It also encourages audiences to appreciate the contributions of robotic explorers whose missions have ended, while inspiring curiosity about planetary science, engineering, and future space exploration.

The project uses AI-assisted creative tools for generating illustrations, and audio elements, alongside presentation and video-editing software for scene composition, synchronization, and final production.

Scientific information and mission references are drawn from NASA resources and the NASA Space Apps Challenge Resources tab. The project combines these materials with original storytelling, visual direction, and editing.

Tools used: [Canva Ai , Chatgpt ]

The project presents space exploration from the perspective of the explorer itself. Instead of treating Ingenuity as a machine in a scientific report, it gives the audience an opportunity to experience its journey as a personal adventure.

Its 2D aesthetic, and appealing visuals create a distinctive storytelling experience.

The project considers scientific accuracy, age-appropriate storytelling, visual accessibility, emotional engagement, and responsible use of AI-generated content. Real mission events are used as the foundation, while AI-generated illustrations are clearly identified. The presentation also distinguishes authentic NASA materials from generated visual content.
